ActionKey.description:
one pose of a custom action. Angles in degrees from straight down, + toward +x: on the front view screen right
(the left arm hangs out at about -16, the right at +16); on a side action FORWARD, the way the figure faces
(arms[0] is then the back arm, arms[1] the front arm, and + lean bends forward)

arms.description: [[upper arm, forearm bend] left, [upper arm, forearm bend] right]; none: at rest
arms.title: Arms

lean.description: whole figure, about the feet; + leans toward +x
lean.title: Lean

legs.description: [left, right] leg angles (rest -6, 6); the feet stay on the ground; none: at rest
legs.title: Legs

t.description: when, as a share of the action's duration
t.title: T

ActionKey.title: ActionKey

CastLook.description:
a named variant of a cast member's look (story: @look <cast>: <name>). Only what it sets changes; everything
else stays the cast member's own. The character keeps its id, name, approval and drawing seed.

props.description: held props, one per hand ([]: none)
props.title: Props

CastLook.title: CastLook

body.description: creature id (built in or library/creatures.json). human (default) and other humanoids are stickmen: face, expressions, costume. Other rigs are drawn in top.color ($main) and top.accent_color ($accent), eyes and mouth only, no costume
body.title: Body

hair.description: wardrobe slots: an id, {"id", "color"} or null

headless.description: creatures with a stump only: the stump instead of the head
headless.title: Headless

looks.description: named variants a story switches to with @look <cast>: <name> (default: back to this entry's own)
looks.title: Looks

eye.description: eye centre (head space; body space without a head): a dot that blinks
eye.title: Eye

mouth.description: mouth centre: opens while talking, hidden when shut
mouth.title: Mouth

CreatureShape.description:
one piece of a creature part, in canvas px, facing right, y down: the body around the ground point under the
creature, every other part around its joint, at rest (legs and arms hang down from it). A stickman stands about
950 px tall; the card is 1024 px wide (x -512..512) and tall (y -1000..24 for the body).

fill.description: $main: the cast member's top colour; $accent: its accent colour (else the creature's); none: outline only. For a line: its colour (default ink)
fill.title: Fill

pts.description: rect: 2 corners; circle / ellipse: the centre; line: 2+ points; poly: 3+ points (closed)
pts.title: Pts

CreatureShape.title: CreatureShape

CustomAction.description:
an in-place move for humanoids (salute, bow, dance...): keyframes the engine blends between. @do <cast>:
<id> plays it; other creatures stand idle through it.

duration.description: seconds for one pass through the keys
duration.title: Duration

facing.description: camera: front view; side: the figure turns to face left or right
facing.title: Facing

loop.description: repeat for the whole shot; false: play once and hold the last key
loop.title: Loop

move.description: side only: units/s across the stage while it plays; + forward, - backward (a moonwalk), 0 in place
move.title: Move

CustomAction.title: CustomAction

accent.description: $accent when the cast member has no accent colour
accent.title: Accent

build.description: humanoid only: proportions and head colour

id.description: the body name used in series.json cast
id.title: Id

joints.description: where each part attaches, ground space: hip, shoulder, neck, wing, tail (not for a humanoid)
joints.title: Joints

parts.description: part -> shapes, drawn in order (later on top; not for a humanoid)
parts.title: Parts

rig.description: how it moves: humanoid (a stickman: face, costume, hands), bird, quadruped, biped (has hands), crawler
rig.title: Rig

id.description: the prop kind used in cast props and @do eat / give
id.title: Id

shapes.description: drawn in order: later ones on top
shapes.title: Shapes

back.description: indoor: the back wall; outdoor: the sky
back.title: Back

default_weather.description: weather each @set of this set starts with (until an @weather); none: clear

kind.description: indoor: floor and back wall; outdoor: wide floor and sky, allows travel shots
kind.title: Kind

kind.description: wardrobe id ("id" or a plain string accepted too): built in flat_cap, postman_cap, bowler, straw_hat, wide_hat, or a library headwear; none
kind.title: Kind

HumanoidBuild.description: a humanoid's proportions as factors of the stickman's (1 = the default human), and its head colour
HumanoidBuild.title: HumanoidBuild

kind.description: wardrobe id: built in shorts, ragged_shorts, trousers, or a library legwear; none
kind.title: Kind

PropShape.description:
one piece of a custom prop, in hand space: the hand at (0, 0), y down, x away from the body (canvas px; the
card is 1024 x 1024 with the figure in the middle 512, the built-in props span about -40..110). Drawn with the same wobbly ink as the built-ins.

fill.description: no fill: outline only (ignored for line)
fill.title: Fill

pts.description: rect: 2 corners; circle: the centre; line: 2+ points; poly: 3+ points (closed)
pts.title: Pts

PropShape.title: PropShape

SetPiece.description:
one primitive of a custom set, in world units: actors stand on y = 0, z = 0, x in -2..2; the back wall of an
indoor set is at z -2.6. Anything across the stage (|x| < 2.2) must sit behind z -1, nothing forward of z 0.6
(the engine checks this stage clearance when it builds the set).

backdrop.description: scenery that is never hidden behind an actor (walls, far hills)
backdrop.title: Backdrop

size.description: box: width, height, depth; cyl: top radius, bottom radius, height; ball: radius; mound: radius, height factor
size.title: Size

SetPiece.title: SetPiece

pid.description: while running: the process running it (a running stage whose process is gone was interrupted)
pid.title: Pid

accent_color.description: suit: the tie colour (no tie when null); dress: the wide hat's ribbon and flower
accent_color.title: Accent Color

number.description: chest number on a white bib
number.title: Number

style.description: the top's wardrobe id ("id" accepted too): built in plain, suit, tank, shirt, dress, or a library top
style.title: Style

colorable.description: the cast member's colour replaces default_color in $color
colorable.title: Colorable

id.description: the id a cast slot uses
id.title: Id

layers.description: drawn in order: later ones on top
layers.title: Layers

WardrobeLayer.description:
one ink shape of a wardrobe item, in canvas px around its anchor (the default human: head radius 150, body 184
wide and 300 tall, legs 220, arms 175). x: across (+ outward on the paired anchors shoulders / arms / hands / legs /
feet, drawn on both sides, mirrored on the left); y: down (arms and legs: along the limb from the shoulder / hip).
Torso anchors scale with body_w x body_h, arms and hands with arm, legs and feet with leg; head anchors (head,
head_top, face, eyes, mouth) are in head space: they scale with the head and turn with the face.

behind.description: drawn behind the head and body (long hair, a cape)
behind.title: Behind

fill.description: $color: the worn colour (the cast member's for a colorable item, else the item's default_color); none: outline only. For a line: its colour (default ink)
fill.title: Fill

pts.description: rect: 2 corners; circle / ellipse: the centre; line: 2+ points; poly: 3+ points (closed)
pts.title: Pts

WardrobeLayer.title: WardrobeLayer

WardrobeSlot.description:
one worn wardrobe item: an id (built in or library/wardrobe.json) and an optional colour for colorable items.
A plain id string is accepted. "none": nothing (in a look: takes the cast member's item off).
WardrobeSlot.title: WardrobeSlot

Weather.description: scene weather, drawn in ink by the engine (weather.js): fog behind the cast, the rest in front
Weather.title: Weather

schema.title: Response List Jobs Api Jobs Get

post.description: delete job history; queued and running jobs are never touched. Returns the jobs that are left.

schema.title: Response Cleanup Jobs Api Jobs Cleanup Post

post.description:
all or nothing: new assets, then the series with its cast and parts (story.md + script-for-tts.txt).
Never overwrites: a clashing id or slug gets a suffix. 409 when the package has errors (validate lists them).
dry run: what the package would create, its warnings and errors (section + pasted-text line). Writes nothing.

schema.title: Response Series List Api Series Get

delete.description: the whole series folder; refused while a job is queued or running on any of its parts, or a render runs

post.description: append cast members to a series; never replaces one (an id already in the series is a 409)

put.description: mass edit (the cast panel's JSON import): update members by id, append new ids; see merge_cast
replace one cast member (same entry shape as NewCast; the id stays); see merge_cast

delete.description: the whole part folder and its series.json entry; refused while a job or render runs on it

put.description: replace story.md; the stages after it see the change on their next run (their inputs hash differently)
Raw mp3 body (no multipart dep). voice.mp3 is protected: replacing it needs ?replace=true.
